description: Turn step-by-step instructions into valid HowTo JSON-LD schema markup.

faqs.a: Enter the how-to name, then add steps one by one with optional times. The tool numbers them automatically.
faqs.q: How do I generate HowTo schema?

faqs.a: You can set an estimated total time (ISO 8601, e.g. PT30M) and per-step times in minutes.
Google may show HowTo rich results with step images; add image URLs per step if you have them.
Copy the JSON-LD into your page <head> and validate with Google's Rich Results Test.
faqs.q: How do I use the output?

howto: Add steps one by one (name, details, optional minutes and image URL).
Set the total estimated time if you like.
Generate, copy and paste the JSON-LD into your page.
title: HowTo Schema Generator
